children: Viking Therapeutics reported positive topline results from its VK2735 maintenance study, showing 22% placebo-adjusted weight loss at Week 33 and successful maintenance with less-frequent dosing.
22% placebo‑adjusted weight loss at Week 33 after weekly VK2735 17.5 mg; no plateau observed through 33 weeks.
Every‑other‑week dosing maintained up to 97% of Week‑21 weight loss vs. 61% for placebo (p<0.0001).
Monthly dosing maintained up to 90% of Week‑21 weight loss vs. 61% for placebo (p=0.0002).
GI adverse event rates and discontinuations during maintenance were similar to placebo, indicating favorable tolerability.
Company will explore oral maintenance regimens and hosted a conference call at 8:00 a.m. ET to discuss topline results.
